verdict.rationale: cubic documents natural-language Q&A about code. You can select code and use 'Add to AI chat' with the diff and codebase as context, ask follow-up questions in PR comments, and use a context-aware chat sidebar. It can also generate fixes for flagged issues. All of this is scoped to understanding and reviewing PR changes, not general debugging or troubleshooting. missing for 10: documented debugging/troubleshooting workflows driven by natural-language queries (e.g., diagnosing runtime errors or bug reports), use of NL queries outside PR review, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
Ask follow-up questions about code changes without leaving the PR
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
The chat sidebar helps you quickly understand and navigate your pull requests (PRs) with intelligent, context-aware assistance directly within cubic.
